tagline: A global provider of retirement services, wealth protection and insurance solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Net income of $863 million reflects the company's ability to generate profits despite financial market volatility and fair value adjustments on guaranteed derivatives, demonstrating the resilience of the diversified business model in annuities,…

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues from premiums, policy fees, investment income and reinsurance activities.
kpis.description: Total revenue for 2025 amounts to $11.6 billion, down from $14.1 billion in 2024, primarily due to lower net premiums driven by fewer jumbo transactions and the divestment of non-core portfolios.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in total revenue due to reduced net premiums following portfolio exits

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit attributable to shareholders after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders for 2025 is $766 million, compared to $1.2 billion in 2024. This 36.9% decrease is primarily attributable to unfavorable fair value movements on guaranteed derivatives linked to interest rate volatility and market performance.
kpis.signal: Decline in net income due to adverse fair value movements on fixed indexed annuity reserves

kpis.name: Net Premiums
kpis.explanation: Total premiums earned from insurance contracts and reinsurance agreements.
kpis.description: Net premiums for 2025 amount to $4.5 billion, down from $8.3 billion in 2024. The 45.8% decrease reflects a selective strategy with fewer jumbo transactions in the PRT segment and the ongoing exit from non-core portfolios.
kpis.signal: Significant decline due to fewer jumbo transactions and divestment of non-core portfolios

kpis.name: Net Investment Income
kpis.explanation: Interest, dividends and miscellaneous investment income earned on portfolio.
kpis.description: Net investment income for 2025 is $5.8 billion, up 36.5% from $4.3 billion in 2024. This increase is supported by a full year contribution from AEL and continued rotation into higher-yielding strategies.
kpis.signal: Significant increase driven by investment portfolio growth and rotation into higher-yielding strategies

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Administrative, distribution and operational costs of running the business.
kpis.description: Operating expenses for 2025 amount to $1.4 billion, largely stable compared to $1.4 billion in 2024. The minor increase reflects additional costs incurred to support ongoing growth.
kpis.signal: Minor increase to support continued business growth

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Cost of financing from debt instruments and warehouse facilities.
kpis.description: Interest expense for 2025 is $379 million, up 4.7% from $362 million in 2024. This increase is primarily attributable to additional borrowings through warehouse facilities to support investment purchases.
kpis.signal: Moderate increase in interest expense due to additional borrowings

kpis.name: Distributable Operating Earnings
kpis.explanation: Non-GAAP measure of operating earnings available for distribution to shareholders.
kpis.description: Distributable operating earnings for 2025 amount to $1.7 billion, up 23.7% from $1.4 billion in 2024. This non-GAAP measure reflects earnings available for distribution after operational adjustments.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in distribution capacity from core operations

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of all assets held by the company.
kpis.description: Total assets as of December 31, 2025, amount to $157.2 billion, up 12.3% from $140.0 billion in 2024, reflecting continued business growth and the integration of AEL.
kpis.signal: Robust balance sheet growth reflecting operational expansion and AEL integration

kpis.name: Adjusted Equity
kpis.explanation: Non-GAAP measure of shareholder equity adjusted for certain items.
kpis.description: Adjusted equity as of December 31, 2025, amounts to $16.8 billion, up 43.2% from $11.8 billion in 2024. This non-GAAP measure reflects the strengthening of the company's capital position.
kpis.signal: Significant strengthening of adjusted capital base

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last six fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.07 in the latest year.

risks.title: Structural dependence on Brookfield for management and administration
risks.score_rationale: Listed first among risk factors under 'Risks Relating to Our Relationship with Brookfield'; strong language ('exercise influence over our company and over any decisions requiring shareholder approval'); permanent structural risk related to the Administration Agreement and Support Agreement; high-weight category for key person/governance in a dependent entity.

risks.title: Multi-jurisdictional regulatory risk in insurance and reinsurance operations
risks.score_rationale: Extensive presence in the filing: BMA, NYDFS, PRA, CIMA, OSFI, NAIC, FCA, Solvency UK, Bermuda Insurance Act, Cayman Insurance Act, ICA Canada; comprehensive language on capital requirements (BSCR, ECR, SCR, RBC); upward trend with UK Consumer Duty and post-Brexit Solvency UK reforms; maximum-weight category for an insurer.

risks.title: Integration and operational risks from recent major acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Three significant acquisitions explicitly cited: AEL (~$4.3B, May 2024), Clearbrook (~$1.1B, Nov 2023), Just Group (~£2.4B, proposed); language of scale ('total consideration of approximately'); upward trend with accelerated external growth strategy; high operational and cultural integration risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and insured data protection
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated Item 16.K on cybersecurity; explicit references to CISO, EISP (Enterprise Information Security Policy), Cyber Code (Insurance Sector Operational Cyber Risk Management Code), and regulations CCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, GLB, FCRA; upward trend in the insurance sector; high-weight category for a manager of sensitive retirement data.

risks.title: Intense competition in annuity and pension risk transfer markets
risks.score_rationale: PRT (pension risk transfer), MYGA, SPDA and annuities mentioned in business overview within a highly competitive institutional market; presence of IMO (independent marketing organizations) as a distribution channel exposed to pricing competition; stable trend but growing pressure from alternative players; moderate weight in the filing.

risks.title: Governance risk related to Brookfield's control over shareholder decisions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned under 'Risks Relating to Our Relationship with Brookfield' with reference to the Partnership and members influencing decisions requiring shareholder approval; multi-class share structure (Class A, B, C) reinforcing Brookfield's control; stable trend but documented risk of conflicts of interest in Item 7.B.

risks.title: Exposure to new U.S. taxes on U.S. subsidiaries (CAMT, BEAT, OBBBA)
risks.score_rationale: U.S. tax risks explicitly mentioned with dedicated acronyms (CAMT, BEAT, OBBBA - One Big Beautiful Bill Act 2025) in risk factors; strong language ('may significantly increase the tax liability of our U.S. subsidiaries'); upward trend with OBBBA 2025; direct impact on profitability of U.S. subsidiaries (AEL, ANGI).

risks.title: PFIC classification risk affecting U.S. shareholders of BNT
risks.score_rationale: PFIC (Passive Foreign Investment Company) risk explicitly mentioned in risk factors with reference to Item 10.E; direct warning language ('could be subject to adverse U.S. federal income tax consequences'); stable trend but structurally inherent to Bermuda domicile; moderate weight as it indirectly affects stock attractiveness.
